
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /selfmod  (/self)                          │
  │  Self-Modification                          │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    View or edit RadSim source code and custom prompt.

  Usage:
    /selfmod
    /selfmod path
    /selfmod prompt
    /selfmod list

  Details:
    Access RadSim's own source code:
    
      • path   — Show the RadSim source directory
      • prompt — View/edit the custom system prompt
      • list   — List all source files

  Examples:
    $ /selfmod path
    $ /selfmod prompt
    $ /self list

  Related: /evolve  /settings
